project.name: AegisNotify
stack: Tailwind 4 (devDependency, not yet adopted in templates)

design.colorMode: dark-first with light theme via [data-theme="dark"] override

motion.installed: none (no Framer Motion / motion package yet)

design.density: high (KPI grids, dense tables, resilience panels)

must: keep existing CSS variable tokens as source of truth
avoid: breaking state-* tint semantics used for circuit breaker states

decisions.decision: Full redesign direction: 'Glass Depth' — glassmorphism + cursor-tilt 3D on card surfaces (KPI/hero/panel/resilience cards), glow-on-hover, layered tinted shadows. Sidebar, grid, navigation model, and density stay as-is. Tilt interaction excluded from dense table rows (Notifications list) for perf.
decisions.scope: all aegis-admin-frontend screens: dashboard, providers, notifications list, notification detail, login, sidebar/topbar
